messages:
oncall-ryan: SLO alert fired for hosted-infer gateway p99 timeouts (5xx + client timeouts) in us-east starting ~12:04 UTC, sustained ~15m. Alert: SLO-burn > 3x, customers reporting errors. incident link: https://incidents/REDWOOD/1769467890 :eyes:

maria-observability: I see a correlated spike in 502/504 rates and a sharp drop in tracing sampling between 12:05-12:15, lots of trace gaps. Dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/hosted-infer/gateway-latency

kyle-runtime: We rolled quant-variant v2 to 10% yesterday at 03:00 UTC, but that shouldn't cause global gateway 5xx. Any capacity or auth flaps? :thinking_face:

helga-support: Several customers opened tickets with 502s and timeouts, one reported "partial responses then hang". No auth 401 spike in support alerts.

sam-infra: Checking infra metrics — edge-proxy p99 CPU and connection queue length jumped at same time. Could be upstream congestion or a fanout storm to KV caches. Scaling event at 11:50 completed normally, no errors in deploy logs.

maria-observability: Quick queries I'm running (Loki/PromQL):
```
sum(rate(http_server_errors_total{service="gateway",env="prod"}[1m])) by (status)

{job="traces"} | json | status = "dropped" | count_over_time(5m)
```
Early results: 502s are concentrated on a subset of gateway hosts (gw-us-east-2a-*). Tracing drop rate ~72% in that window.

kyle-runtime: I can’t see kernel panics, but K/V cache latency had a tail at the same time. Could be batcher backlog causing upstream timeouts. Any throttles firing?

helga-support: Billing service showed a transient write error at 12:02 (S3 write errors) — probably unrelated but worth checking. Also two customers on dedicated pools reported no impact.

trace-bot: Trace coverage alert: sampling-rate-delta > 50% for gateway between 12:04-12:16. Link: https://tracing/alerts/1769467890

maria-observability: There's a trace gap pattern: requests that incurred prefetch calls then stalled on a long RPC to model-hosts. Traces end at gateway with no downstream spans. Suggest enabling debug headers for a few requests to capture upstream flow.

sam-infra: Temp mitigation options: 1) route traffic away from gw-us-east-2a to other AZs, 2) throttle prefix-heavy customers, 3) enable fallback model variant (smaller) at routing layer. I'd prefer 1 + 3 to reduce tail.

oncall-ryan: Can someone run a repro curl to exercise the failing path and attach X-Req-Id? Eg:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Debug: 1" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-open-7b","prompt":"hello"}'
```
Collect logs from gateway host shown in Grafana.

kyle-runtime: I'll flip routing for 10% of us-east traffic off gw-us-east-2a to test. Doing `kubectl patch svc gateway -n prod ...` now. :zap:

maria-observability: Added a Loki query pinned to those hostnames and a temporal panel for dropped traces. Also increased trace sampling for incoming traffic from 12:30 for extra coverage.

helga-support: Escalated to accounts with active incidents and sent mitigation note. Will collect example request IDs from customers.

sam-infra: Routing change applied, traffic rebalanced off gw-us-east-2a. Early signs: 502 rate down 40% in 2m. Scaling a couple gateway pods as extra capacity.

maria-observability: After reroute, p99 latency improved and trace gap reduced. Still seeing isolated 504s for long-running prefetch RPCs. Suggest kernel-level profiling on model-hosts later.

laura-product: Any customer-facing blast we should send? If it's mostly regional and we're rerouting, maybe a short status update.

oncall-ryan: Agreed — helga can publish a short status: regional degradation detected in us-east, mitigation in progress, no global data loss, follow-up when fully resolved. :thumbsup:

kyle-runtime: Root cause hypothesis: batcher/backpressure in specific gateway AZ caused request queues to pile, upstream RPCs timed out producing 502/504 and trace sampling dropped. Will run deeper analysis on batcher metrics and KV latency.

maria-observability: Follow-ups: add host-level alerting for trace-drop spikes, add a dashboard slice for prefetch RPC tail latencies, and check tracing instrumentation for possible drop points.

oncall-ryan: Who owns the postmortem? Assigning to kyle-runtime + maria-observability. I'll keep the incident open until we have RCA. Closing slack thread for now but will update when RCA done. :white_check_mark:
